name: VC Dimension / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension (square-root)
details: For finite binary classes, $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)=O(\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)^2)$; equivalently, VC dimension is at least a constant multiple of the square root of no-clashing teaching dimension.
proof: Proposition 23 of Kirkpatrick--Simon--Zilles gives $\mathrm{NCTD}\leq\mathrm{PBTD}=\mathrm{RTD}$ for finite classes. Apply the explicit quadratic RTD bound of Hu--Wu--Li--Wang to obtain $\mathrm{NCTD}\leq39.3752\,\mathrm{VC}^2-3.6330\,\mathrm{VC}$.
